# WebUsageKind

What one metered web call (`WebUsageRecord`) paid for.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"Search"` | One page of search results for one query. |
| `"Page"` | One web page read through the scraping provider, on the tier that succeeded. |
| `"Download"` | One file (or page) downloaded directly by Maitento, not through the provider. |
| `"ImageDescription"` | One downloaded image described by the image-describing model. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`WebUsageRecord`](web-usage-record.md)
